header.name: mcs51_health_pot HIL-EXCLUSIVE: relay contact weld oracle (TCO / bimetal hardware fallback)
header.description: PLAN-20260915 Task 3 scene 5. Relay contact welding has no self-sensing path on this board (no current transformer loop), so weld detection is an HIL-exclusive oracle backed by the bimetal snap disc and the non-resettable thermal fuse. The simulation only records the commanded relay sequence as an event log; it MUST NOT be used as weld-protection release evidence.

steps.description: Firmware commands the contact closed (event-log evidence only; not weld detection)
Firmware commands the contact open: OFF edges are immediate
Safe standby telemetry after the commanded OFF (contact-stuck scenario is HIL-only)
